note_en: 稍 … 就 … means "the slightest … and right away …": 稍 "slightly" shows that a small slip is enough, and 就 that the result follows at once. In the text: 稍有一个不熟悉的小区，就可能耽误好几分钟 "hit just one unfamiliar compound and you can lose several minutes"; 稍晚一分钟，系统上的倒计时就会变成红色 "be one minute late and the countdown turns red." It's a lighter cousin of 一…就….
